market_pulse.note: About $65,607 late Sunday afternoon, down 2.27% over 24 hours (The Block), after an overnight low of $61,946 on Coinbase; the 24-hour range ran from about $62,081 to $67,442 (CryptoTicker).
About $1,806, down 2.28% over 24 hours (The Block); ether, XRP and Solana have each lost about 22% over the past week (Bitcoin Foundation).
About $2.19 trillion, up 0.83% over 24 hours as prices recovered from overnight lows (CoinMarketCap).
About 59.3% of total crypto market value (CoinMarketCap).

themes.title: Rebound from a three-month low
themes.summary: Bitcoin fell to $61,946 overnight, its lowest in about three months, then bounced about 5% within an hour; by late afternoon it was near $65,600 (CryptoTicker; crypto.news; The Block).

themes.title: Weekly close tonight
themes.summary: The weekly candle closes at midnight UTC (7 p.m. ET); the week opened at $74,757, pointing to a loss of roughly 12% to 13%, and CME bitcoin futures reopen with a gap below Friday's close near $68,200 (CryptoTicker).

themes.title: Leverage flushed out
themes.summary: About $1.96 billion of crypto positions were liquidated over 24 hours, including about $750 million in bitcoin; roughly 80% were long bets (CoinGlass data via crypto.news).

themes.title: Sentiment at extreme fear
themes.summary: The Fear & Greed Index read 10 on Sunday, down from 13 on Saturday and 20 on Friday (CryptoTicker).

themes.title: Rate-hike pricing and yields weigh
themes.summary: October consumer prices rose 0.4% on the month, and futures markets price a quarter-point Fed hike in December; analysts also point to rising bond yields and margin calls tied to the AI and Nvidia selloff (CryptoTicker; Bitcoin Foundation).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin was down 2.27% and ether down 2.28% over 24 hours late Sunday (The Block).

categories.name: Large-cap altcoins
categories.note: Solana traded near $71.26, down 2.39% over 24 hours (KuCoin), after falling about 22% for the week along with XRP (Bitcoin Foundation).

categories.name: DeFi and privacy coins
categories.note: Mixed: Aave rose 4.99% and Zcash 5.16%, while Morpho fell 5.59% and Curve DAO 4.98% over 24 hours (CoinMarketCap).

categories.name: Derivatives and ETFs
categories.note: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs had about $1.91 billion of net outflows over seven sessions through Nov. 13, and ether ETFs lost about $399 million last week (crypto.news; CryptoTicker).

watch_list.why: The overnight low of $61,946 and the $60,000 round number are the nearest reference points below, with the 2026 low of $57,718 from July 1 further down; $65,564 and $67,442 are recent highs above (CryptoTicker).

watch_list.topic: ETF flows when U.S. markets reopen
watch_list.why: Spot ETFs do not trade on weekends; the next flow figures follow Monday's Nov. 16 session, after seven straight days of bitcoin ETF outflows (crypto.news).

watch_list.topic: Nvidia earnings, Fed minutes and the Anthropic IPO
watch_list.why: Nvidia reports Tuesday, minutes from the Oct. 27-28 Fed meeting are due Wednesday, and Anthropic is expected to debut on Nasdaq Thursday (Stockopedia).
